Yes, in most cases. Albert reimburses overdraft fees charged by your external bank when they're caused by pre-authorized transfers Albert initiates, including Smart money withdrawals. You can receive up to 2 reimbursements in total.

To request one, contact customer support within 90 days of the original charge and include a screenshot of your banking app or statement showing both the overdraft fee and the Albert transaction that caused it. The reimbursement goes to the Albert account that caused the overdraft, and it can't be sent to a closed account.
